content:
Amazon’s Black Friday week is drawing to a close, but it’s not over yet – the prices for the main Samsung Galaxy S26 trio have dropped even further.
![Samsung Galaxy S26 Ultra](https://fdn.gsmarena.com/imgroot/news/26/11/deals-us-galaxy-s26-series/phone/-159/gsmarena_001.jpg)
![Samsung Galaxy S26 Ultra](https://fdn.gsmarena.com/imgroot/news/26/11/deals-us-galaxy-s26-series/phone/-159/gsmarena_002.jpg)
![Samsung Galaxy S26+ and Galaxy S26](https://fdn.gsmarena.com/imgroot/news/26/11/deals-us-galaxy-s26-series/phone/-159/gsmarena_003.jpg)
![Samsung Galaxy S26+ and Galaxy S26](https://fdn.gsmarena.com/imgroot/news/26/11/deals-us-galaxy-s26-series/phone/-159/gsmarena_004.jpg)
Samsung Galaxy S26 Ultra • Samsung Galaxy S26+ and Galaxy S26
The Samsung Galaxy S26 Ultra was $350 off when the sales event started – now the discount has grown to $450. This means that the base 12/256GB model starts at under $1,000. Doubling the storage is still a $200 upgrade, though.
Check out our written and video reviews of the S26 Ultra for a closer look at the phone. Also, the S26 Ultra vs. iPhone 18 Pro Max comparison is very relevant for the US market.
The Samsung Galaxy S26+ only got a minor drop – the base 12/256GB model is now $20 cheaper than it was at the start of Black Friday week, while the 12/512GB model costs the same. That is a solid $300 discount, but we’d rather have the S26 Ultra for $50 more.
The US market has three major flagships in the 6.3” class, including the Samsung Galaxy S26. The other two are the iPhone 18 Pro and the Pixel 11 Pro, of course. The Google phone is also on sale and the base 12/256GB model costs $50 less than the Galaxy. That said, the S26 has the much better chipset – a Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 vs. a Tensor G6. The iPhone 18 Pro is not on sale right now. Anyway, at the start of Black Friday week, a 256GB S26 cost $850 and the 512GB variant was $1,020.
PS. The Samsung Galaxy S26 FE dropped to $500/$600 for the 128GB/256GB configurations for Black Friday week, but that discount ends on Saturday.
We may get a commission from qualifying sales.
